title: Negocio (Odoo)
description: Pedidos, productos, stock, compras, listas de proveedores, precios y actividad, leídos de la base de Odoo con un usuario de solo lectura (ADR 0028). Sin datos personales de clientes.

panels.title: Pedidos hoy
panels.description: Impresos en los puestos (o cobrados) desde las 0 h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND (o.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba') >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')

panels.title: Importe de los pedidos hoy
panels.description: Con IVA.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(o.amount_total), 0) FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND (o.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba') >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')

SELECT count(*) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.state IN ('purchase', 'done') AND (po.date_approve AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba') >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')

panels.title: Facturas de proveedor en excepción
panels.description: «Se debe pagar: Excepción» (no coincide con la orden, lo recibido o el total del papel).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM account_move m WHERE m.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund') AND m.state != 'cancel' AND m.release_to_pay = 'exception'

panels.title: Precios para cambiar
panels.description: En «Precios a actualizar», sin contar las diferencias chicas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM product_template pt, res_company rc WHERE rc.id = (SELECT min(id) FROM res_company) AND pt.active AND pt.comercio_precio_desactualizado AND NOT (COALESCE(rc.comercio_diferencia_chica, 0) > 0 AND abs(COALESCE(pt.comercio_precio_variacion, 0)) <= rc.comercio_diferencia_chica)

panels.title: Códigos de fábrica por escanear
panels.description: Productos con el código propio 20… y sin marcar «No tiene código de fábrica» (ADR 0025).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM product_product pp JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE pp.active AND pt.active AND pt.type = 'consu' AND pp.barcode LIKE '20%' AND NOT COALESCE(pt.comercio_sin_codigo_fabrica, false)

panels.title: Pedidos por día y puesto
panels.description: Pedidos impresos en cada puesto (los cobrados en una caja cuentan para el puesto que los armó).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', (o.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba' AS time, COALESCE(c.name->>'es_AR', c.name->>'en_US') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND $__timeFilter(o.date_order) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Importe por día y puesto
panels.description: Total de los pedidos con IVA.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', (o.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba' AS time, COALESCE(c.name->>'es_AR', c.name->>'en_US') AS metric, sum(o.amount_total) AS value FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND $__timeFilter(o.date_order) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pedidos por hora del día (horas pico)
panels.description: Suma de todo el período elegido.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(extract(hour FROM (o.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba'))::text, 2, '0') || ' h' AS hora, COALESCE(c.name->>'es_AR', c.name->>'en_US') AS puesto, count(*) AS pedidos FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND $__timeFilter(o.date_order) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pedidos por día de la semana
panels.description: Suma de todo el período elegido.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(isodow FROM (o.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba'))::int || ' ' || (ARRAY['lun','mar','mié','jue','vie','sáb','dom'])[extract(isodow FROM (o.date_order AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba'))::int] AS dia, COALESCE(c.name->>'es_AR', c.name->>'en_US') AS puesto, count(*) AS pedidos FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND $__timeFilter(o.date_order) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resumen por puesto (período elegido)
panels.description: Anulados: impresos que nadie cobró (regla de la última caja).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(c.name->>'es_AR', c.name->>'en_US') AS "Puesto", count(*) AS "Pedidos", COALESCE(sum(it.items), 0) AS "Ítems", sum(o.amount_total) AS "Importe", round(avg(o.amount_total), 2) AS "Promedio por pedido", count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.state = 'cancel') AS "Anulados" FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(l.qty) AS items FROM pos_order_line l WHERE l.order_id = o.id) it ON true WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND $__timeFilter(o.date_order) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Más vendidos (período elegido)
panels.description: Cobrados (o dados por cobrados en la registradora).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(pp.default_code || ' · ', '') || COALESCE(pt.name->>'es_AR', pt.name->>'en_US') AS "Producto", sum(l.qty) AS "Cantidad", sum(l.price_subtotal_incl) AS "Importe", count(DISTINCT o.id) AS "Pedidos" FROM pos_order_line l JOIN pos_order o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN product_product pp ON pp.id = l.product_id JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced') AND $__timeFilter(o.date_order) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Sin movimiento hace $dias días (con stock)
panels.description: Productos con stock que no entraron ni salieron en ese plazo (elegir los días arriba).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(pp.default_code || ' · ', '') || COALESCE(pt.name->>'es_AR', pt.name->>'en_US') AS "Producto", s.cantidad AS "Stock", (SELECT max((m.date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) FROM stock_move m WHERE m.product_id = pp.id AND m.state = 'done') AS "Último movimiento" FROM (SELECT q.product_id, sum(q.quantity) AS cantidad FROM stock_quant q JOIN stock_location l ON l.id = q.location_id WHERE l.usage = 'internal' GROUP BY q.product_id) s JOIN product_product pp ON pp.id = s.product_id JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE s.cantidad > 0 AND pp.active AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_move m WHERE m.product_id = pp.id AND m.state = 'done' AND m.date >= now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - make_interval(days => ${dias:sqlstring}::int)) ORDER BY 3 NULLS FIRST LIMIT 50

panels.title: Stock negativo
panels.description: Se vendió más de lo que figuraba: falta cargar una compra o un ajuste de inventario.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(pp.default_code || ' · ', '') || COALESCE(pt.name->>'es_AR', pt.name->>'en_US') AS "Producto", s.cantidad AS "Stock" FROM (SELECT q.product_id, sum(q.quantity) AS cantidad FROM stock_quant q JOIN stock_location l ON l.id = q.location_id WHERE l.usage = 'internal' GROUP BY q.product_id) s JOIN product_product pp ON pp.id = s.product_id JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE s.cantidad < 0 ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 50

panels.title: Por debajo del mínimo (reglas de reabastecimiento)
panels.description: Solo productos con regla de mínimo cargada (Inventario → Reabastecimiento). Vacío si no hay reglas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(pp.default_code || ' · ', '') || COALESCE(pt.name->>'es_AR', pt.name->>'en_US') AS "Producto", op.product_min_qty AS "Mínimo", COALESCE((SELECT sum(q.quantity) FROM stock_quant q JOIN stock_location l ON l.id = q.location_id WHERE q.product_id = op.product_id AND l.usage = 'internal' AND l.parent_path LIKE ol.parent_path || '%'), 0) AS "Stock" FROM stock_warehouse_orderpoint op JOIN stock_location ol ON ol.id = op.location_id JOIN product_product pp ON pp.id = op.product_id JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = pp.product_tmpl_id WHERE op.active AND COALESCE((SELECT sum(q.quantity) FROM stock_quant q JOIN stock_location l ON l.id = q.location_id WHERE q.product_id = op.product_id AND l.usage = 'internal' AND l.parent_path LIKE ol.parent_path || '%'), 0) < op.product_min_qty ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50

panels.title: Movimientos de stock por día
panels.description: Líneas de movimiento hechas (un pedido con 5 productos = 5).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', (m.date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba' AS time, CASE WHEN o.usage = 'supplier' THEN 'Entradas de proveedores' WHEN d.usage = 'customer' THEN 'Ventas y salidas a clientes' WHEN o.usage = 'customer' THEN 'Devoluciones de clientes' WHEN d.usage = 'supplier' THEN 'Devoluciones a proveedores' WHEN 'inventory' IN (o.usage, d.usage) THEN 'Ajustes de inventario' ELSE 'Otros' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM stock_move m JOIN stock_location o ON o.id = m.location_id JOIN stock_location d ON d.id = m.location_dest_id WHERE m.state = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(m.date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Órdenes de compra confirmadas por día

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', (po.date_approve AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba' AS time, 'órdenes' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.state IN ('purchase', 'done') AND $__timeFilter(po.date_approve) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', (po.date_approve AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba' AS time, 'importe' AS metric, sum(po.amount_total) AS value FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.state IN ('purchase', 'done') AND $__timeFilter(po.date_approve) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Facturas de proveedor cargadas por día

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', (m.create_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba' AS time, CASE WHEN j.comercio_sin_factura THEN 'Compras sin factura' WHEN m.release_to_pay = 'exception' THEN 'En excepción' ELSE 'Facturas' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM account_move m JOIN account_journal j ON j.id = m.journal_id WHERE m.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund') AND m.state != 'cancel' AND $__timeFilter(m.create_date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recepciones pendientes
panels.description: Mercadería pedida que todavía no se recibió en Odoo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS "Recepción", p.origin AS "Origen", pr.name AS "Proveedor", (p.scheduled_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba') AS "Prevista", GREATEST(0, extract(day FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - p.scheduled_date))::int AS "Días de atraso" FROM stock_picking p JOIN stock_picking_type pt ON pt.id = p.picking_type_id LEFT JOIN res_partner pr ON pr.id = p.partner_id WHERE pt.code = 'incoming' AND p.state NOT IN ('done', 'cancel', 'draft') ORDER BY p.scheduled_date LIMIT 50

panels.title: Facturas en excepción o con el total que no cierra
panels.description: Excepción: no coincide con la orden o con lo recibido (account_3way_match). «No cierra»: el total leído del papel distinto del de Odoo (en un borrador, el de Odoo se actualiza al guardar).

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.name AS "Factura", m.ref AS "Número del proveedor", pr.name AS "Proveedor", m.invoice_date AS "Fecha", m.amount_total AS "Total en Odoo", m.comercio_total_factura AS "Total del papel", CASE WHEN m.comercio_total_factura IS NOT NULL AND abs(m.comercio_total_factura - m.amount_total) > 0.01 THEN 'No cierra el total' ELSE 'Excepción' END AS "Problema" FROM account_move m LEFT JOIN res_partner pr ON pr.id = m.partner_id WHERE m.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund') AND m.state != 'cancel' AND (m.release_to_pay = 'exception' OR (m.comercio_total_factura IS NOT NULL AND abs(m.comercio_total_factura - m.amount_total) > 0.01)) ORDER BY m.invoice_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

panels.title: Compras sin factura abiertas (ADR 0023)
panels.description: Registradas en el diario sin factura, a la espera de la factura real (la administración las anula a mano al cargarla).

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.name AS "Comprobante", pr.name AS "Proveedor", m.date AS "Fecha", m.amount_total AS "Total", m.payment_state AS "Pago", (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')::date - m.date) AS "Días" FROM account_move m JOIN account_journal j ON j.id = m.journal_id LEFT JOIN res_partner pr ON pr.id = m.partner_id WHERE j.comercio_sin_factura AND m.state = 'posted' ORDER BY m.date LIMIT 50

panels.title: Última importación por lista
panels.description: «Días» vacío = nunca se aplicó. Alerta: más de 14 días sin importar. Filas para revisar: de la importación más nueva, si todavía está para revisar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pr.name AS "Proveedor", concat_ws(' · ', l.name, l.parte) AS "Lista", l.frecuencia_dias AS "Cada (días)", (SELECT max(i.fecha) FROM comercio_lista_importacion i WHERE i.lista_id = l.id AND i.estado = 'aplicada') AS "Última aplicada", (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - (SELECT max(i.fecha) FROM comercio_lista_importacion i WHERE i.lista_id = l.id AND i.estado = 'aplicada')::date AS "Días", v.estado AS "Estado de la última", CASE WHEN v.estado = 'simulada' THEN v.cant_revisar END AS "Filas para revisar" FROM comercio_lista_proveedor l JOIN res_partner pr ON pr.id = l.partner_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT i.estado, i.cant_revisar FROM comercio_lista_importacion i WHERE i.lista_id = l.id AND i.estado NOT IN ('error', 'descartada') ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 1) v ON true WHERE l.active ORDER BY 5 DESC NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Importaciones por día
panels.description: Por estado actual (aplicada, simulada = para revisar, reemplazada, descartada, error).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', (i.create_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba')) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba' AS time, i.estado AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM comercio_lista_importacion i WHERE $__timeFilter(i.create_date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cambios de costo de proveedores (7 días)
panels.description: Precios de proveedor que cambiaron (cada lista aplicada o carga a mano).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM product_supplierinfo s JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.price FROM product_supplierinfo a WHERE a.partner_id = s.partner_id AND a.product_tmpl_id = s.product_tmpl_id AND a.comercio_escala_de_id IS NULL AND a.id < s.id AND a.date_end IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) ant ON true WHERE s.comercio_escala_de_id IS NULL AND s.date_start >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba'))::date - 7 AND s.price != ant.price

panels.title: Precios para cambiar
panels.description: «Precios a actualizar» en rojo o verde.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (COALESCE(rc.comercio_diferencia_chica, 0) > 0 AND abs(COALESCE(pt.comercio_precio_variacion, 0)) <= rc.comercio_diferencia_chica)) FROM product_template pt, res_company rc WHERE rc.id = (SELECT min(id) FROM res_company) AND pt.active AND pt.comercio_precio_desactualizado

panels.title: Diferencias chicas (ocultas)
panels.description: Por debajo del porcentaje de «Diferencia chica»: no vale la pena cambiarlos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(rc.comercio_diferencia_chica, 0) > 0 AND abs(COALESCE(pt.comercio_precio_variacion, 0)) <= rc.comercio_diferencia_chica) FROM product_template pt, res_company rc WHERE rc.id = (SELECT min(id) FROM res_company) AND pt.active AND pt.comercio_precio_desactualizado
SELECT count(*) FROM product_template pt WHERE pt.active AND pt.comercio_etiqueta_pendiente

panels.title: Cambios de costo de la semana
panels.description: Precio del proveedor (por su unidad de compra) contra el anterior del mismo proveedor. Ordenados por el cambio más grande.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.date_start AS "Desde", pr.name AS "Proveedor", COALESCE(s.product_code || ' · ', '') || COALESCE(pt.name->>'es_AR', pt.name->>'en_US') AS "Producto", ant.price AS "Antes", s.price AS "Ahora", round(100 * (s.price - ant.price) / NULLIF(ant.price, 0), 1) AS "Cambio %" FROM product_supplierinfo s JOIN res_partner pr ON pr.id = s.partner_id JOIN product_template pt ON pt.id = s.product_tmpl_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.price FROM product_supplierinfo a WHERE a.partner_id = s.partner_id AND a.product_tmpl_id = s.product_tmpl_id AND a.comercio_escala_de_id IS NULL AND a.id < s.id AND a.date_end IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) ant ON true WHERE s.comercio_escala_de_id IS NULL AND s.date_start >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Cordoba'))::date - 7 AND s.price != ant.price ORDER BY abs(s.price - ant.price) / NULLIF(ant.price, 0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

panels.title: Qué hizo cada usuario (período elegido)
panels.description: Usuarios de Odoo (administración, compras, depósito). Los cajeros y puestos son empleados: van en la tabla de al lado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(up.name, u.login) AS "Usuario", x.que AS "Qué", count(*) AS "Cantidad" FROM ( SELECT po.create_uid AS uid, 'Órdenes de compra confirmadas' AS que FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.state IN ('purchase', 'done') AND $__timeFilter(po.date_approve) UNION ALL SELECT m.create_uid, CASE WHEN j.comercio_sin_factura THEN 'Compras sin factura cargadas' ELSE 'Facturas de proveedor cargadas' END FROM account_move m JOIN account_journal j ON j.id = m.journal_id WHERE m.move_type IN ('in_invoice', 'in_refund') AND $__timeFilter(m.create_date) UNION ALL SELECT p.write_uid, 'Recepciones validadas' FROM stock_picking p JOIN stock_picking_type pt ON pt.id = p.picking_type_id WHERE pt.code = 'incoming' AND p.state = 'done' AND $__timeFilter(p.date_done) UNION ALL SELECT i.create_uid, 'Listas de proveedores importadas' FROM comercio_lista_importacion i WHERE $__timeFilter(i.create_date) UNION ALL SELECT a.create_uid, 'Ajustes de inventario' FROM stock_move a JOIN stock_location o ON o.id = a.location_id JOIN stock_location d ON d.id = a.location_dest_id WHERE a.state = 'done' AND 'inventory' IN (o.usage, d.usage) AND $__timeFilter(a.date) ) x JOIN res_users u ON u.id = x.uid LEFT JOIN res_partner up ON up.id = u.partner_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

panels.title: Pedidos por empleado del puesto (período elegido)
panels.description: Empleado con PIN que armó el pedido (pos_hr).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(o.cashier, '(sin empleado)') AS "Empleado", COALESCE(c.name->>'es_AR', c.name->>'en_US') AS "Puesto", count(*) AS "Pedidos", sum(o.amount_total) AS "Importe" FROM pos_order o JOIN pos_config c ON c.id = COALESCE(substring(o.pos_reference from '^[0-9]+-([0-9]+)-')::int, o.config_id) WHERE (o.comercio_en_caja OR o.state IN ('paid', 'done', 'invoiced')) AND $__timeFilter(o.date_order) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
